diagnosis: carcinoma invasor NST mama direita, G2

treatments.name: Mastectomy right + axillary lymph node dissection

control: Post‑treatment PET‑CT (20‑06‑2025) showed no residual uptake in the operated breast and reduced axillary nodes, no distant sites. Hemogram and liver/renal function normal. ECOG‑PS 0, no pain or palpable nodes, surgical scar healed, alopecia improving, nausea resolved. Comorbidity: hypertension treated with ramipril 5 mg. Planned follow‑up: breast MRI on 10‑01‑2026, PET‑CT on 10‑04‑2026, DXA before 01‑12‑2025, lipid and glucose monitoring every 3 months.
